::api-operation{method="PATCH" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/decline_rules/{rule}"}
#docs
A field left ABSENT is not written; a field set to `null` CLEARS that part and hands the rule's own answer back. The two are different intents and one optional field cannot express both.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `rule` | `string` | **yes** | The decline rule's id. |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is optional.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `retriable` | `boolean` | no | Whether a charge that fails under this rule can succeed on a retry. |
| `message` | `string` | no | The message shown for a failure under this rule. |
| `exposed_to_payer` | `boolean` | no | Whether the message is shown to the payer. |
| `gateway_account` | `string` | no | Scope this setting to one account. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `decline_rule`. One of `decline_rule`. |
| `id` | `string` | e.g. stripe.code.expired_card |
| `overridable` | `boolean` | False for a code we recognise that no RULE names. Its answer is still real and a code-level override still governs it; there is simply no rule id to aim a rule-level PATCH at, and one aimed there answers 404. |
| `gateway` | `string` | The gateway this rule applies to. One of `stripe`, `paypal`, `razorpay`, `gocardless`, `braintree`, `cashfree`, `authorizenet`, `adyen`, `checkoutcom`, `mollie`, `square`, `payu`, `cybersource`. |
| `matches` | `object` | The predicate that selects this rule. First match wins. |
| `code` | `string` | Our canonical code, e.g. expired_card |
| `error_id` | `string` | The canonical code on the namespaced axis: gateway.&lt;family&gt;.&lt;code&gt;, using Eleven families, so an imported book aggregates with ours. |
| `family` | `string` | The rule's decline family. |
| `built_in` | `object` | The rule's built-in behavior. |
| `override` | `object` | Null until this business changes something. |
| `effective` | `object` | What collection will actually do. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | Invalid body |
| `404` | No such business, rule, or gateway account |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X PATCH "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/decline_rules/mkr_XXXXXXXXXXXX01" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "retriable": false,
    "message": "Requested by the customer."
  }'
```
